message.content:
I am speech: breath made audible, thought given tongue, silence broken into meaning.

I live in vibration—air pressed into waves by lungs, shaped by throat, tongue, teeth, and lips. I travel earward, become nerve, become sense.

I am more than words. I am cadence and pause, emphasis and pitch. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, wound, or heal. I can be honest or performed; precise or slurred; fluent or halting.

I exist only in time. The moment I’m made, I’m already passing. Yet I linger—in memory, in record, in consequence.

I am what happens when you decide not to keep it inside.
